olivia.h: Quick sync  vendor kickoff Wed 09:00 PT. Final scope check: KMS presign flow, ephemeral assessor roles, audit-to-SIEM latency SLA.

rahul.k: Schedule RBAC changes in a tight 2h window (08:30-10:30 PT). We need a named approver list for emergency elevates.

sam.t: Agree. Use ephemeral/assessor chain + short TTL presigns (15m). Ops: reserve a retest slot and snapshot policy.

jin.w: Staging presign tested. Lambda calls keystore-proxy -> kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext + s3:PutObject. In prod we must grant the lambda key usage; assessor principals must NOT have Decrypt. I'll publish minimal IAM snippet in the runbook.

olivia.h: Intake must auto-create vuln tickets (project: pen-2026-q2) capturing severity, repro steps, owner, retest ETA. Add labels: requires-kms-review and rbac when applicable.

ops-bot: [ephemeral-bake] ephemeral/assessor-bake-20260715T07:00Z -> expires 20260715T11:00Z.

rahul.k: For KMS audit: ensure CloudTrail logs key usage (Sign/Generate) and that key-usage metrics are forwarded to audit index. Deny kms:Decrypt for external assessor roles.

sam.t: Retest plan: 4h window 7 days after fix. Keep env + keystore snapshots 72h post-retest. Ops reserve confirmed?

jin.w: I'll wire the intake form webhook to create GH issues and include a CloudTrail validation step in the runbook. Example quick check: aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=Username,AttributeValue=assessor-redprobe | jq '.Events[] | select(.EventName=="Decrypt")'

olivia.h: IR rule: if vendor demonstrates an active exploit chain, escalate to oncall-SOC and open #incidents. That path is handled outside the normal remediation/retest flow.

rahul.k: I'll draft the approver list and escalation mapping. Jin: aim to post runbook + form by EOD tomorrow.

jin.w: Will do. Posting runbook link here when ready.

olivia.h: Action owners: Jin (runbook + form + policy snippet), Rahul (approver list + escalation mapping), Sam (reserve retest window + snapshot retention). Closing thread; thanks all.
